metadata.description: Official JieGou plugins for Claude Code — governed AI workflow automation with approval gates, audit trails, and RBAC.

plugins.name: jiegou
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to JieGou for governed AI operations: enroll this machine as a substrate worker (console-approved work in, audited results back), plus API tools to run recipes and workflows. Your subscription does the work; the plane makes it governed.
plugins._version_note: 0.15.2 pins the draft-post FAILED-close card shape (hookId + structured kill/keep judgment call with recommended flag) so the cockpit Reporting triage renders one-click Kill hook / Keep rows (orion cockpit/reporting-triage); 0.15.1 fixes the MCP server launch: .mcp.json ran `bun src/server.ts` relative to the session cwd (the user's project), so the server exited with Module not found and every session logged CONNECTION_CLOSED; it now runs ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/server.ts, matching the hooks; 0.15.0 adds operating facts: gtm.py pull also fetches /api/gtm/operating-facts (dated, sourced facts about the account's own operation — weekly stats + curated entries; seats read-only, expired facts never served), and draft-post uses them as the ONLY source for an only-me line, citing the fact id in approverNotes (orion feat/operating-facts); 0.14.0 adds structured draft checks: when the account's editorial guide sets draftChecks {hookVariants, onlyMe}, draft-post writes N hook variants (>=1 first-person) and names an only-me element (or flags ONLY-ME NEEDED first in approverNotes, never inventing an operating fact), carries both on the card payload, and li_lint.py --meta enforces them as HARD fails; accounts without draftChecks are unaffected (founder ruling 2026-10-01, console counterpart orion feat/editorial-guide-draft-checks); 0.13.3 stops the draft-post batch review card: notes for the approver ride the gated post card as payload.approverNotes, and a B5 card is filed only when a hook dispatch closes FAILED (founder ruling 2026-09-23; the headless pull prompt in setup_pull.py says the same); 0.13.2 adds gtm.py propose-hooks: unattended reddit-research rounds submit candidate hooks as status=proposed (fenced from dispatch/autopilot/drafting-grounding until console approval on /jiegou/reddit flips proposed->idea and stamps the approver; console counterpart orion PR #6726) — candidates become structured curate-able rows instead of markdown-only; 0.13.0 gives seats a cover-image path without cloud credentials: render_cover.py ported (brand font shipped; dual repo/plugin layout), substrate.py asset uploads bytes to the plane which does the storage write, draft-post renders + uploads + passes coverUrl. Replaces the seat-local coverPath that produced phantom cover references (2026-08-10); 0.12.0 adds the reply-draft skill: executes plane-dispatched reply-sweep-draft commands (X reply candidates -> <=278-char measured drafts, rec+alt, anti-rhyme, one B2 card per thread keyed x-reply:<statusId>, mandatory command close) — never posts to X, human sends everything; 0.11.1 duplicate-draft hardening (the DSO incident): gtm.py state surfaces the plane’s canonical externalId with an ADOPT warning on hook-dedupe redirects; draft-post skill mandates adopting it for push/gated and ALWAYS closing every pulled command via report --command (unclosed = re-dispatched = duplicate); 0.11.0 adds SSE-wake (spec 2026-08-13): substrate.py wake daemon (per-seat doorbell stream, 45s dead-connection detection, backoff reconnect, 10-min heartbeat floor) + setup_pull.py install --wake (launchd KeepAlive instead of interval polling) — dispatch→draft-start goes from up-to-30-min to ~seconds on an awake seat; 0.10.2 fixes item-less command close (report --command alone → PUT commands complete — first unattended run delivered drafts but could not close its 3 hook-dispatch commands); 0.10.1 hardens unattended pull (2026-08-13 field findings): wrapper concurrency lock (PID file — the 30-min tick no longer races a long draft session) + headless permission bootstrap at install (seat settings.json allowlist + workspace trust — without both, headless runs auto-deny every plugin-script call and execute nothing); 0.10.0 adds L1 progress-streaming (substrate.py start/progress verbs + phase-boundary skill instructions — the cockpit watches runs live); 0.9.0 adds the competitive-intel tenant plugin skill (C4 — Competitive Pulse framed by the account's own competitor set + lens, git-free plane artifact, KB-grounded, headless-safe) + gtm.py ci-recs; 0.8.0 added gtm.py ci-config (C4 seed); 0.7.0 added reddit-research (R4); 0.6.0 added gtm.py kb-search (pathway 3)
